subject: english
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.

The captain and his sailors __was surrounding__ by pirates.
solution:
The correct answer is **"were surrounded"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct sentence will be: "**The captain and his sailors were surrounded by pirates."**
 
• As the subject is in the **third person plural form** "was" will be replaced by "were&
